difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a flat morphism f : Y -> X of algebraic spaces over S and a finite type quasi-coherent F on X with scheme theoretic support Z, the preimage f^{-1}(Z) is the scheme theoretic support of f^*F (source lines 6244-6251).
